title: Compact assist popovers and deep-link cards
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Design and deliver a compact in-product assist pattern: lightweight popovers that anchor to UI controls, plus deep-link doc cards that allow users to open relevant docs/screenshots without leaving the flow. Objectives: reduce cognitive overhead for first-run flows, keep screenshots and help context tightly scoped to the control, and provide stable deep links for analytics and routing. Deliverables include Figma assets (responsive popover + card variants), a screenshot guide for engineering, microcopy variants for novice/advanced modes, and a handoff packet with acceptance criteria and integration notes.
acceptance_criteria: Popover sizing scales correctly at 320px, 768px, and desktop widths
Card includes deep link that opens documentation in the Console right-pane or in a new tab depending on user preference
Copy variations for 'Novice' and 'Power user' modes are approved by PM
Assets exported as SVG/PNG and uploaded to /design-assets/onboarding/popovers/
Engineering has an integration spec with placement guidelines, ARIA attributes, and animation timings
screenshot_notes: Primary screenshot: popover anchored to 'Create Deployment' button with condensed step bullets (no more than 3)
Secondary: sidecar card showing 'Where to find model versions' with highlighted config fields
Show responsive breakpoints: collapsed mobile, stacked tablet, and docked desktop sidecar
Include 2-second GIF demonstrating open/close animation for handoff
design_decisions: Use a 10px corner radius and 12px inner padding to preserve visual density without feeling cramped
Prefer inline deep links that open the Console side panel when available; fallback to docs.redwood.com in new tab
Keep microcopy under 80 characters per line; use truncated bullet style with 'Learn more' CTA
Avoid overlay masking for non-critical tips to prevent interrupting short flows
accessibility_notes: Popovers must be reachable by keyboard and dismissible with ESC
Ensure focus trap for popovers that contain interactive elements; otherwise return focus to trigger
Provide aria-describedby linking the control to the popover content and aria-expanded state on trigger
Contrast ratio for CTAs must meet 4.5:1 in default theme
implementation_notes: Animation duration: 160ms ease-out for enter, 120ms ease-in for exit
Prefer CSS transform with opacity for better compositor performance
Provide CSS variables for spacing and radius to allow runtime theming
Suggest adding telemetry hook: tooltip_shown, tooltip_action_clicked with source=compact_assist
